dataset_preprocessing.details: CIC-IDS2017 CSV loading, cleaning, binary label conversion (BENIGN=0, ATTACK=1); StandardScaler fit on train only; stratified train/test split; scaler.pkl, feature_names.json, label_mapping.json, constant_features.json saved; processed arrays X_train 2,017,889x70 / X_test 504,473x70; reports/experiment_manifest.json generated.

centralized_ml.details: MLPIDS nn.Module fix applied (src/models/mlp.py:38); architecture 128-64-32, BatchNorm, dropout 0.3, BCEWithLogitsLoss; trained 20 epochs batch_size=256 Adam lr=0.001; metrics verified from JSON: accuracy 0.9771, precision 0.9616, recall 0.9001, f1 0.9298, roc_auc 0.9981. CPU-only; no hyperparameter tuning.

federated_learning.details: Manual FedAvg (no Ray/Flower) ran 50 rounds to completion; 5 clients, non-IID Dirichlet alpha=0.5, local_epochs=5, batch_size=128, lr=0.001, warm start from centralized checkpoint, sample-weighted aggregation; final accuracy 0.9587, f1 0.8770. Flower/Ray path not executed (sandbox port binding blocked).

differential_privacy.details: src/privacy/dp_sgd.py — DPSGDTrainer (Opacus 1.6.0 + manual fallback), gradient clipping + Gaussian noise, moments-accountant epsilon/delta accounting; DP-FedAvg ran 30 rounds to completion; final epsilon=0.1457 at delta=1e-05; no BatchNorm on clients (DP-incompatible); models/federated_mlp_dp.pth and models/dp_federated_results.json saved.

evaluation_testing.details: 50 unit tests across 5 files (test_mlp 8, test_federated 6, test_dp 10 with 1 skip, test_preprocessing 11, test_dashboard 14); all pass (0 failed, 0 errors); run via unittest (pytest unavailable, network blocked). reports/test_results.md documents results.

documentation_reproducibility.details: Root README.md created; 8 docs files (ARCHITECTURE, DATASET, PREPROCESSING, CENTRALIZED_TRAINING, FEDERATED_LEARNING, DIFFERENTIAL_PRIVACY, EVALUATION, REPRODUCIBILITY); PROJECT_SYNOPSIS.md corrected (removed RF/XGBoost and false DP claims); dashboard/backend/requirements.txt updated (flwr added); final deliverables generated (model_comparison.json, final_project_audit.md, final_project_status.json, privacy_report.json).
